answer_1.quote: Furthermore, we extend our work to T5 encoderdecoder models and Arabic generative tasks.
answer_1.outputs: generated dialogues, summaries, questions, and answers

answer_2.quote: We use ROUGE to evaluate models on the TS task and BLEU for QA, QG and EMD tasks.

answer_4.quote: Thus, we evaluate our T5-based and AraB2B models on the three generation tasks of QG, EMD and TS using human annotators.
answer_4.guideline: We asked the annotators to label a hundred outputs from each model and each task for two scenarios: (1) Acceptable: each model output is labeled for whether it is acceptable (not strictly perfect) to the annotator or not, and (2) Best: where the annotator must pick exactly one best output out of the three ones.
